claims.exact_statement: For every n and every genuine Boolean quadratic phase f(x)=(-1)^{q(x)} on F_2^n, every physical coordinate satisfies Delta_i U(f)<=3 Inf_i(f). Consequently G(f)<=3I(f). The class is restriction closed and 3 is its sharp supremum.
claims.quantifiers: Every n>=0, every quadratic polynomial including every alternating polar-matrix rank and every affine/constant term, every physical coordinate; base-two U.
proof_dependencies: standard flat-on-an-affine-coset Walsh law for quadratic phases
elementary equal-fiber property of a linear projection
prior clique-quadratic sharpness family at canonical commit 4b5c51804df04c0f4d5fecc679f49367297112db
claims.supersedes: B01-A003-CLIQUE-QUADRATIC-GU-v1 in class scope, but preserves its sharper explicit formula
claims.first_unproved_line: For degree at least three, child spectra need not be uniform translates of one affine space; no dimension-free bound on the average cross/within upper-fiber logarithm is proved.

claims.exact_statement: Every quadratic Boolean phase satisfies U(f)<=I(f) and H(f)<=2I(f).
claims.quantifiers: Every dimension, polar rank, affine shift, and constant sign.
claims.first_unproved_line: This direct class endpoint does not extend to arbitrary Boolean spectra.
